issueReference.title: Finish P1-7b after integration review found missing example-catalog coverage

reviewContext.userProblem: Astra rejected the missing replacement-example catalog entries, stale mock counts and misclassified P1-7b failure; unchanged dispatch ownership prevented repair.
requiredOutcomes: Review, checkpoint and non-force push the exact design/plan/manifest amendment before dispatch; then include both replacement bundles in shared catalog validation/mock coverage and reconcile observed expected counts.
Validate both replacement bundles and deterministic mocks against documented stable outputs.
Prove seven real task lifecycle cases, including rejected-gate recovery, with positive test counts and stable replay.
Pass both exact task-backed recovery and standalone rejected-required-gate regressions separately on final source.

Record final-source build, V1 before-removal, affected suites, V8, V11, strict touched-file SwiftLint, diff checks, source identity and serial broad regression with full logs and honest failure classification.
Obtain formal test-integrity, single Sol adversarial and Astra combined-tree acceptance; complete B4 documentation, then publish exact reviewed paths.
nonGoals: P1-7a legacy removal, legacy example deletion, or closure of parent P1.

Reconstruction of P1-6 slices, new CLI/schema/public APIs or orchestration abstraction, SQLite terminal immutability changes, unrelated broad failure repairs, Monja work, broad formatting, lockfile regeneration or global plan archiving.
constraints: Preserve checkpoint bffa1da4ab161892ecec54784439e6148860f302, eight dirty P1-7b implementation/progress files and unrelated work.
Keep coupled source and test edits serial under one owner; write each plan progress only to impl-plans/progress/p1-dispatch.md; use tmp for scratch and full logs.
Only Sources/RielaCLI/WorkflowRunCommand.swift is additionally authorized production source; any further production path requires another bounded reviewed amendment.
Preserve real WorkStore/TaskDispatch/WorkflowRunCommand tests, initial gate rejection, causal recovery, distinct second attempt/session and replay stability; do not weaken assertions or seed success.
No reset, stash, revert, force push, broad staging, main merge, additional worktree or concurrent Git operation.
Classify fresh broad failures on final source; resolve new or P1-7b-owned failures, and keep unrelated failures explicitly FAILED with owner/follow-up.
Add only the two catalog/parity test paths to existing serial ownership; preserve all assertions and previously implemented behavior.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Bounded test-only ownership amendment resolves the material Astra catalog finding without new production scope. Retain prior task-gate correction and seven lifecycle cases.

Carry actual taskReservation presence into RunFinalizeContext at both call sites and skip only applyRequiredLoopGateFailureIfNeeded for reserved task runs; this preserves completed canonical sessions and rejected gate evidence for ordinary task recovery.
Keep standalone required-gate failure status and evidence, genuine runner failure/cancellation, SQLite terminal immutability and dispatcher/director policy unchanged.
Retain repair then required verification and one bounded director worker; existing bundle shapes and store fixture constrain edits to demonstrated inconsistencies.
Use real reservation, runner reconciliation and decision application for seven cases; deterministic workflow mocks supplement but cannot replace ledger evidence.
Keep coupled source, tests, harness and bundles in one implementation plan; reserve shared documentation and publication for serial B4 after formal reviews.
intentionalTradeoffs: Retain legacy examples while proving P1-7b replacement behavior before separately reviewed P1-7a removal.
Allow unrelated broad failures only as explicitly classified FAILED follow-ups with formal slice-only review disposition; only a complete passing broad command may be reported as passing.
supportedEdgeCases: Rejected required gate retains a completed canonical session and rejected evidence; causal verification recovery consumes a pending request and uses a distinct bounded second attempt/session.
Standalone rejected required gate retains failed exit/status and inspectable canonical and artifact evidence.
Guard stop with durable evidence and repeat dispatch; capacity zero with no attempt, canonical session or lease.
Bounded director decision; child-only success cannot accept failed judged work.
Reopened-store once-only child accounting and invalid-output human escalation without recursive repair or duplicate charge.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Repeated-finding guard behavior from the gate-visit fixture.
P1-7a removal and unrelated broad regression fixes.

planReview.reviewScope: Planning acceptance only; catalog repair, behavioral verification, formal implementation reviews, and publication remain pending.

acceptanceCriteria: Both replacement bundles appear in the shared catalog and deterministic mock execution; only affected expected counts change based on observed results; every assertion remains intact.
Both replacement bundles validate and deterministic mocks complete with documented stable outputs.

Real task lifecycle tests prove acceptance, rejected-gate recovery, guard stop, capacity wait, bounded director decision, once-only child accounting and invalid-output escalation with positive counts.
Exact task-backed recovery and standalone rejected-required-gate regressions each pass separately with positive counts; final-source before-removal V1 and affected suites pass.
Build, V8 mocks, V11, strict touched-file SwiftLint, diff checks, source identity and serial broad regression have complete final-source evidence and honest failure classification.
Formal test-integrity, single Sol adversarial and Astra combined-tree reviews accept no material P1-7b defect; B4 docs/progress leave P1-7a, parent P1 and unrelated broad follow-ups open.
Only exact reviewed paths are committed and non-force pushed after review and documentation gates.
